summary: The swimming case is directly testable from FishBase's open 'speed' table (269 records, 89 species, Speedms with fish Length and Mode). For flight, AVONET gives mass and wing dimensions for all birds but no speeds, and the only repository speed dataset found is a Procellariiform compilation; the classic cross-species flight-speed sets (Alerstam et al. 2007 radar data) are paper supplements. For walking, no repository table of characteristic speed vs. leg length or body length across species was found; Movebank's API needs a login (401) and gives routine GPS speeds without length.
next_step: Pre-register the swimming exponent test on FishBase speed.parquet (log Speedms vs log Length, by Mode); for flight and walking compile Alerstam 2007 S1 and a published mammal walking-speed table into a repository dataset before testing.
obstacles_confirmed: Tracked speeds are mostly routine movement, not minimum flight speed, sprint speed, or pendulum walking speed.
Characteristic speed must be standardized across tracking studies (FishBase mixes burst and sustained modes in one table).
